name: VF-NeRF
aliases: Viewshed Fields for Rigid NeRF Registration
definition: A neural volume rendering method that uses Vector Fields to represent indoor scenes, learned from multi-view posed images and their monocular depth maps.
summary: VF-NeRF rigidly aligns two NeRFs without known camera poses by using Viewshed Fields to generate informative virtual viewpoints for photometric alignment.
